parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID.

parameters.name: DnsRecord
parameters.description: Overrides the DNS record for the origin request.

parameters.name: Follow302Enable
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to follow 302 redirects for origin requests. Valid values:

- `on`: Follows 302 redirects.

- `off`: Does not follow 302 redirects.

parameters.name: Follow302MaxTries
parameters.description: The maximum number of 302 redirects to follow. The value must be an integer from 1 to 5.

parameters.name: Follow302RetainArgs
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to retain the original request parameters when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the parameters.

- `off`: Does not retain the parameters.

parameters.name: Follow302RetainHeader
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to retain the original request headers when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the headers.

- `off`: Does not retain the headers.

parameters.name: Follow302TargetHost
parameters.description: The `Host` header for the redirected origin request.

parameters.name: OriginHost
parameters.description: The `Host` header for the origin request.

parameters.name: OriginHttpPort
parameters.description: The origin server port for HTTP requests.

parameters.name: OriginHttpsPort
parameters.description: The origin server port for HTTPS requests.

parameters.name: OriginMtls
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to enable mutual TLS (mTLS) for origin requests. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables mTLS.

- `off`: Disables mTLS.

parameters.name: OriginReadTimeout
parameters.description: The read timeout period for the origin server, in seconds.

parameters.name: OriginScheme
parameters.description:
The protocol for origin requests. Valid values:

- `http`: The origin request uses HTTP.

- `https`: The origin request uses HTTPS.

- `follow`: The origin request uses the same protocol as the client request.

parameters.name: OriginSni
parameters.description: The Server Name Indication (SNI) for the origin request.

parameters.name: OriginVerify
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to enable origin certificate verification. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables verification.

- `off`: Disables verification.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description:
Indicates whether to use range requests when fetching files from the origin server. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables range requests.

- `off`: Disables range requests.

- `force`: Enforces range requests.

parameters.name: RangeChunkSize
parameters.description:
The size of each chunk for range requests. Valid values:

- 512KB

- 1MB

- 2MB

- 4MB

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which is a conditional expression that matches user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression, such as `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`.

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the rule is enabled. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables the rule.

- `off`: Disables the rule.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The execution priority of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.
